mitigation_descriptions: Ensure password complexity and rotation policies are enforced so compromised password hashes are harder to crack.
Restrict read permissions to sensitive credential files like /etc/shadow and audit sudoers configuration to limit unauthorized access.
Manage and audit user privileges and sudo permissions to prevent unauthorized execution of commands accessing sensitive credential files.
reasoning: The adversarial findings confirm unauthorized access to /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd via sudo by user kford on intranet-server, representing credential dumping technique T1003.008. Immediate containment is required to prevent credential cracking and lateral movement.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (192.168.2.114) from the network to prevent potential lateral movement. 2. Terminate active sessions and temporarily disable the compromised account kford. 3. Review and audit sudoers configuration on intranet-server to revoke improper sudo permissions for sensitive file access. 4. Force a password reset for all accounts whose hashes were exposed in /etc/shadow. 5. Inspect system logs and audit trails on agent 32 for evidence of credential exfiltration or subsequent unauthorized access.
